register_parser_qwen: register the QwenToolCallParser class under the name 'qwen' in the parser registry
get_parser_qwen: get a QwenToolCallParser instance by calling get_parser('qwen') from the tool call parsers module
list_parsers: list all registered tool call parser names including 'qwen', 'hermes', and others
parse_hermes_format: parse raw model output text containing tool call tags into structured ChatCompletionMessageToolCall objects
parse_qwen_format: parse raw model output text with qwen tool call tags into structured ChatCompletionMessageToolCall objects
